title: Lesson 6.3: Intrusion Detection & Prevention

Shield intrusion sensor (Relay Console for TechLab)

story.victory: Vex's next password storm hits the sensor and stops dead. Volt's drill scan runs without a single alert. Volt: "Now it watches AND acts, and it knows a friend from an enemy."

config.reply: % A sensor in promiscuous mode only sees a copy. It cannot block anything until it is inline.
% Saved. The brute force is signature 2001219; block it with action deny-attacker-inline.
% Saved, but the memo names the drill scanner and its signature (1000123, 192.168.20.5).

steps.title: Read the night
steps.body: Type `enable`, then `show alerts` and `more flash:drill-memo.txt`. Which alert came from anomaly-based detection? `submit ANOMALY=A<n>`. Which one is a false positive? `submit FALSEPOS=A<n>`. And this sensor watches a network link: `submit SENSOR=NIDS` or `HIDS`?

steps.title: From watching to blocking
steps.body: Run `show sensor mode`. In `conf t`: `sensor mode inline`, then `signature 2001219 action deny-attacker-inline` (the SSH brute force). `end`, then `show alerts`.

objectives.label: SSH brute force signature blocks the attacker

steps.title: Tune out the false alarm
steps.body: Volt's drill scanner is 192.168.20.5, authorized in the memo. In `conf t`: `signature 1000123 exclude source 192.168.20.5`.

objectives.label: Drill scanner excluded from the port-sweep signature
